proposal_backends.llm: direct OpenAI-compatible API proposes the evaluation batch (preflight)
proposal_backends.ldm: direct API occurrences -> empirical q0 -> RBF GP-UCB LDM sampling (preflight)
proposal_backends.harness: one persistent Pi session proposes the evaluation batch (Responses preflight)
proposal_backends.ldm_harness: independent persistent Pi sessions -> empirical q0 -> fixed LDM sampling
proposal_backends.ldm_harness_compiled: ldm_harness plus an independent policy session compiling prior_mean@1 and ldm_weights@1
proposal_backends.bo: unsupported: no score-blind LLM-free program generator is defined

deviations: Only the real-data table is run; the synthetic Switch-Feature and State tables are omitted.
State classifier, top-k 0.1, test batch 50, folds 0-4.
Only the CIFAR100 (N=10) table is run; ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A and CUB200 are omitted.
Rehearsal-free config with tuned_epoch 5, init_lr 0.01, batch 48, seeds 1992-1994.
Queries use a seed-0 1000-image subset of the COCO Karpathy test split (scripts/prepare_case_data.py cmr).
Only the Table 1 BLIP ViT-B/16 image-shift row is run.
The pinned upstream task provides no training loop; the SAC stack in resources/cases/support/improving_replay_buffers/rl_runner.py is task-local and fixed.
Only DMC cheetah-run, 100000 environment steps, seeds 0 and 1; results are not comparable to published tables.

settings.candidate: Complete Python module for the case slot; static rules in resources/cases/catalog.json
settings.evaluation_isolation: fresh workspace from SHA-256 verified pinned files per candidate; one process group per job, terminated as a tree on timeout
settings.comparison_axis: official-grader evaluations (one evaluation = the full declared job matrix of one candidate)
settings.api_cost: measured tokens x configured prices; cap checked before each request/turn
